blockers: GitHub Actions remains account/runner-infrastructure blocked: deterministic, browser and postgres jobs terminate before any executable step with runner_id 0; this is neither a source pass nor a source failure.
Vercel preview/deployment status is currently rate-limited by the account/build limit and therefore provides no new source evidence.

The repository cannot force the ChatGPT UI to attach GitHub or files to a completely disconnected new conversation; that session needs repository/file access once, then npm run brain or AGENTS.md can self-bootstrap it.
Shared-chat URLs are not durable memory because a future runtime may be unable to open them; material history must be imported from accessible exports/uploads/content.
Real provider credentials, sender infrastructure, customer demand, cleared payment, accepted delivery, renewal, exact legal/tax conclusions and elapsed founder-absence duration remain external proof.
